articles.title_en: Dismantling old or forging new clientelistic ties? Sudan’s civil service reform after uprising
articles.title_cn: 拆除旧有的还是缔结新的庇护关系？苏丹起义后的公务员制度改革
articles.abstract_en: Civil service reform is often a top priority for popular movements that unseat autocracy, and during democratization campaigns more broadly: when a deposed regime had relied upon a clientelistic state to stay in power, in which bureaucrats were rewarded for using their authority to further the interests of the regime and its top elites, new political elites have strong incentives to undertake changes to the state and its personnel upon taking over. Yet despite initially-aligned politician incentives for civil service reform in post-uprising contexts, we highlight how bureaucratic actions can serve as a causal antecedent to new politicians’ subsequent stymieing of reform. Bureaucrats can leverage their embedded knowledge of state processes to forge clientelistic ties with new political elites. This in turn prompts politicians to use their power to block attempts to create more rational-legal agencies. We trace these dynamics through in-depth qualitative and ethnographic data of (failed) efforts to reform Sudan’s civil service after the 2018–19 popular uprising which unseated a 30-year autocracy. Overall, this paper helps explain why so many recent popular uprisings that have come to power have been unable to deliver the large-scale transformative reform upon which they were launched by focusing attention on the elements of the former autocracy that survived the transition.
articles.abstract_cn: 公务员制度改革往往是推翻专制统治的民众运动的首要任务，在更广泛的民主化运动中也是如此：当被推翻的政权依赖庇护主义国家来维持权力，官僚因其利用职权促进政权及其高层精英利益而获得回报时，新的政治精英在接管政权后有强烈动机对国家及其人事进行改革。然而，尽管在起义后的背景下，政治家的激励最初与公务员制度改革一致，我们强调官僚行为如何成为新政治家随后阻碍改革的因果先导。官僚可以利用其对国家程序的嵌入知识，与新政治精英缔结庇护关系。这反过来促使政治家利用其权力阻止建立更理性的法律机构的尝试。我们通过深入的定性和民族志数据追踪这些动态，这些数据涉及2018-19年民众起义推翻30年专制统治后苏丹公务员制度改革（失败）的努力。总体而言，本文通过关注前专制政权中在过渡中幸存下来的元素，有助于解释为何许多近期上台的民众起义未能实现其发起时所承诺的大规模变革性改革。

articles.title_en: The BRI: A new development cooperation paradigm in the making? Unpacking China’s infrastructure cooperation along the Maritime Silk Road
articles.title_cn: 一带一路：正在形成的新型发展合作范式？解析中国在海上丝绸之路的基础设施合作
articles.abstract_en: This special issue aspires to contribute to the nascent literature on the developmental impact of the Belt and Road Initiative (BRI) and its implications for global development governance. It is our contention that the BRI offers a unique window for a better understanding of China’s dual role as a development agent and a development-norms shaper. This introductory essay attempts to systematize theoretical insights drawn from in-depth empirical research along key nodes of the 21st Century Maritime Silk Road (MSR), one key dimension of the BRI.
articles.abstract_cn: 本特刊旨在为关于一带一路倡议（BRI）发展影响及其对全球发展治理影响的早期文献做出贡献。我们认为，一带一路为更好地理解中国作为发展推动者和发展规范塑造者的双重角色提供了一个独特窗口。这篇导论性文章试图系统化从21世纪海上丝绸之路（MSR）关键节点深入实证研究中得出的理论见解，这是BRI的一个关键维度。

articles.title_en: Revisiting the role of secondary towns: How different types of urban growth relate to poverty in Indonesia
articles.title_cn: 重新审视次级城镇的作用：不同类型的城市增长与印度尼西亚贫困的关系
articles.abstract_en: There is increasing interest in assessing whether big city growth has effects that differ from the effects of secondary town growth, especially in terms of impacts on poverty. It can be difficult to study these issues with typical sub-national economic data because urban growth often occurs outside the administrative boundaries of cities. An emerging literature therefore uses remote sensing to measure patterns of urban growth without being restricted by limitations of data for administrative areas. We add to this literature by combining poverty estimates from annual socio-economic surveys fielded from 2011 to 2019 with remote sensing data on night-time lights for 41 big cities and for secondary towns in 497 Indonesian districts. We measure growth on the extensive (lit area) and intensive (brightness within lit area) margins, and distinguish between growth of big cities and of secondary towns and our spatial econometric models allow global and local spillovers. The extensive margin growth of secondary towns is associated with lower rates of poverty but no similar association holds for big city growth. These patterns corroborate earlier findings from India. Potential productivity advantages of big cities and concerns about agricultural land loss to expanding towns may imply that urban growth patterns that favour big cities are warranted, while on the other hand these new results suggest, from a poverty reduction point of view, that policies to favour secondary towns may be warranted. Policymakers in countries like Indonesia therefore face difficult trade-offs when developing their urbanization strategies.
articles.abstract_cn: 越来越多的研究关注大城市增长的影响是否与次级城镇增长的影响不同，尤其是在对贫困的影响方面。由于城市增长往往发生在城市的行政边界之外，使用典型的次国家经济数据来研究这些问题可能很困难。因此，新兴文献使用遥感来测量城市增长模式，而不受行政区域数据限制的约束。我们通过将2011年至2019年年度社会经济调查的贫困估计与印度尼西亚497个县中41个大城市和次级城镇的夜间灯光遥感数据相结合，为这一文献做出贡献。我们测量了广泛边际（照明区域）和集约边际（照明区域内的亮度）的增长，并区分了大城市和次级城镇的增长，我们的空间计量模型允许全局和局部溢出效应。次级城镇的广泛边际增长与较低的贫困率相关，但大城市增长没有类似的关联。这些模式证实了早期在印度的发现。大城市潜在的生产率优势和城镇扩张导致农业用地流失的担忧可能意味着有利于大城市的城市增长模式是合理的，而另一方面，这些新结果表明，从减贫的角度来看，支持次级城镇的政策可能是合理的。因此，像印度尼西亚这样的国家的政策制定者在制定城市化战略时面临艰难的权衡。

articles.title_en: Earthquakes and mental health
articles.title_cn: 地震与心理健康
articles.abstract_en: Earthquakes may seriously deteriorate mental health by generating fear and stress as a result of economic and human losses. However, mental health has also been found to improve as a result of greater social cohesion in affected communities after such events. We examine the short-run effects of earthquakes on a wide set of mental health outcomes in Ecuador. To this end, we combine hospital admissions, death records, and survey data with precise measures of local seismic activity to exploit the plausibly random spatial and temporal nature of earthquake intensity. We find that damaging earthquakes decrease the propensity to be admitted, the number of days of hospitalisation for mental and behavioural disorders, and deaths to suicides. Estimates from nationally-representative surveys provide evidence of increased life satisfaction, trust, and religious observance, suggesting a possible explanation for the fall in hospital admissions and suicides after an earthquake.
articles.abstract_cn: 地震可能通过造成经济损失和人员伤亡而产生的恐惧和压力，严重恶化心理健康。然而，也有研究发现，此类事件后受灾社区的社会凝聚力增强，心理健康状况有所改善。我们研究了厄瓜多尔地震对一系列广泛心理健康结果的短期影响。为此，我们将医院入院记录、死亡记录和调查数据与当地地震活动的精确测量相结合，利用地震强度在空间和时间上看似随机的特性。我们发现，破坏性地震降低了因精神和行为障碍入院的倾向、住院天数以及自杀死亡人数。来自全国代表性调查的估计提供了生活满意度、信任和宗教仪式参与度提高的证据，这可能解释了地震后入院和自杀人数下降的原因。

articles.title_en: Impacts of hydropower development on locals’ livelihoods in the Global South
articles.title_cn: 全球南方水电开发对当地生计的影响
articles.abstract_en: The construction of hydroelectric dams in the Global South and emerging economies is controversial; on one hand, advocates highlight the positive impacts at national and global scales, such as national development and independence from fossil fuels. On the other hand, opponents of dams stress the negative social-ecological impacts on the livelihoods of communities near construction sites, and the lack of local communities participation in the decision making processes. Scholars have published a range of case studies exploring the impacts of dams. However, there is no comprehensive understanding of how hydroelectric dams impact people’s livelihoods and capital globally. In this study, we present a comparative medium-N survey exploring the impacts of 33 large-scale dams on people’s natural, social, human, financial, and physical capital and the pathways of conditions that explain the changes in these capital in the Global South. To do so, we used the information from a qualitative meta-analysis of the social impacts of dams and fuzzy-set qualitative comparative analysis (fsQCA). Our results show that the types of people’s capital are impacted differently by the construction: natural, social, human, and financial capital are negatively impacted, whereas physical capital is often positively impacted. The fsQCA showed three main groups of pathways that explain the changes in capital. First, the study indicates that lack of local communities participation in decision-making processes negatively impacts all capital but physical. Second, regardless of the nation’s energy security, megadams generate primarily negative impacts on natural, social, and human capital and positive impacts on physical capital. Third, our results indicate the importance of the World Commission on Dams in raising international awareness about the social-ecological impacts of dams despite a country’s energy-security status.
articles.abstract_cn: 全球南方和新兴经济体建设水电站大坝颇具争议；一方面，支持者强调其在国家和全球层面的积极影响，如国家发展和摆脱对化石燃料的依赖。另一方面，反对者则强调大坝对建设地点附近社区生计的负面社会生态影响，以及当地社区在决策过程中缺乏参与。学者们发表了大量案例研究探讨大坝的影响。然而，对于水电站大坝如何在全球范围内影响人们的生计和资本，目前尚无全面认识。在本研究中，我们进行了一项比较性中等样本调查，探讨33座大型大坝对人们自然、社会、人力、金融和物质资本的影响，以及解释全球南方这些资本变化的路径条件。为此，我们使用了关于大坝社会影响的定性元分析信息和模糊集定性比较分析（fsQCA）。我们的结果表明，不同类型的资本受到建设的影响不同：自然、社会、人力和金融资本受到负面影响，而物质资本往往受到正面影响。fsQCA显示了三大类路径来解释资本的变化。首先，研究表明，当地社区在决策过程中缺乏参与对所有资本产生负面影响，但物质资本除外。其次，无论国家的能源安全状况如何，大型大坝主要对自然、社会、人力资本产生负面影响，对物质资本产生正面影响。第三，我们的结果表明，世界大坝委员会在提高国际社会对大坝社会生态影响的认识方面具有重要意义，尽管国家能源安全状况不同。

articles.title_en: License to educate: The role of national networks in colonial empires
articles.title_cn: 教育许可：殖民帝国中的国家网络作用
articles.abstract_en: Colonial Africa was shaped by a variety of European actors. Of foremost importance in the educational sector were both colonial governments and Christian mission societies. While their activities and long-term implications are often analyzed in isolation, few systematic studies investigate relationships between them. However, it is well-known that underfunded colonial governments supported mission societies, who used schools to attract new converts, as low-cost educational providers. In this paper, we argue that mission societies that shared national ties with colonial governments benefitted from increased support and engaged in more extensive educational activities. Using new historical data on Protestant mission societies from the interwar period in Africa, we demonstrate that national alignment between mission societies and colonizer’s identity in British Africa was associated with more primary schools and higher enrolment. We discuss and explore potential channels underlying this dynamic, including financial support for missionary activities as well as the granting of access to more favourable locations. Our findings show that national networks are an important but understudied aspect of colonial empires. Furthermore, analyzing the early expansion of education provides insights on the causal links often assumed by studies focused exclusively on long-term effects.
articles.abstract_cn: 殖民时期的非洲受到多种欧洲行为体的塑造。在教育领域，殖民政府和基督教传教团体最为重要。尽管它们的活动和长期影响常常被孤立分析，但很少有系统性研究探讨它们之间的关系。然而，众所周知，资金不足的殖民政府支持传教团体，后者利用学校吸引新信徒，作为低成本教育提供者。在本文中，我们认为，与殖民政府共享国家纽带的传教团体获得了更多支持，并开展了更广泛的教育活动。利用非洲战间期新教传教团体的新历史数据，我们证明，在英属非洲，传教团体与殖民者身份的国家一致性与小学校的增多和入学率的提高相关。我们讨论并探索了这种动态背后的潜在渠道，包括对传教活动的财政支持以及获得更有利地点的许可。我们的发现表明，国家网络是殖民帝国中一个重要但研究不足的方面。此外，分析教育的早期扩展为通常仅关注长期影响的研究所假设的因果联系提供了见解。

articles.title_en: Household welfare effects of ROSCAs
articles.title_cn: 轮转储蓄和信贷协会的家庭福利效应
articles.abstract_en: We examine the effects of Rotating Savings and Credit Associations (ROSCAs) on household welfare in India. The identification strategy is based on household fixed effects and instrumental variables (using the geographic leave-one-out instrument). We find that ROSCA membership increases household assets, consumption, energy efficiency and school expenditure, but only in rural areas. Welfare effects are stronger for poorer households and for those living in communities with stronger social ties. We argue that the persistence and success of ROSCAs depends on social ties, which are often stronger in rural communities.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了轮转储蓄和信贷协会（ROSCAs）对印度家庭福利的影响。识别策略基于家庭固定效应和工具变量（使用地理留一法工具）。我们发现，ROSCA成员资格增加了家庭资产、消费、能源效率和学校支出，但仅限于农村地区。福利效应对于较贫困家庭和生活在社会联系更紧密社区的家庭更为显著。我们认为，ROSCAs的持续存在和成功取决于社会联系，而社会联系在农村社区往往更为紧密。

articles.title_en: Resource rents, coercion, and local development: Evidence from post-apartheid South Africa
articles.title_cn: 资源租金、强制与地方发展：来自后种族隔离南非的证据
articles.abstract_en: We examine how the dismantling of coercive institutions associated with the end of apartheid in South Africa in 1994 affected the distribution of natural resource rents, and thereby impacted local economic development. Individual-level data from 1993 to 2015 reveal that relative real wages of Black workers increased at a significantly faster pace in the mining industry than in other sectors. Community-level data from the 1996 and 2011 population census reveal that this pattern helped explain the evolution of relative incomes of the former self-governing territories set aside for Black inhabitants. Using data from the 1996 census, we document large income gaps between communities located just-inside and just-outside the former self-governing territories set aside for Black inhabitants. Examining relative changes between 1996 and 2011, we find that spatial income convergence was considerably stronger among marginalized communities with higher initial exposure to resource rents. These results accord with bargaining theory in which the dismantling of coercive institutions improves the negotiating position of unionized workers in the mining industry.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了与1994年南非种族隔离制度终结相关的强制性机构的废除如何影响自然资源租金的分配，并进而影响地方经济发展。1993年至2015年的个体层面数据显示，黑人工人的相对实际工资在采矿业中的增长速度显著快于其他行业。1996年和2011年人口普查的社区层面数据显示，这一模式有助于解释原为黑人居民划定的自治领地相对收入的演变。利用1996年人口普查数据，我们记录了位于原黑人自治领地内外的社区之间存在巨大的收入差距。通过考察1996年至2011年间的相对变化，我们发现，在初始资源租金暴露较高的边缘化社区中，空间收入趋同明显更强。这些结果与讨价还价理论相符，即强制性机构的废除改善了采矿业工会工人的谈判地位。

articles.title_en: Chinese capital, regulatory strength and the BRI: A tale of ‘fractured development’ in Cambodia
articles.title_cn: 中国资本、监管强度与“一带一路”倡议：柬埔寨“碎片化发展”的故事
articles.abstract_en: The scholarly debate on how developing countries can effectively manage Chinese-sponsored infrastructure and investment (particularly since the launch of the Belt and Road Initiative,BRI) has largely focused on cross-country variations. Less attention has been devoted to within-country variations: why can certain sectors within a country better align Chinese corporate activities with their domestic development objectives than others? This study examines within-country variations by comparing Sino-Cambodian infrastructure cooperation at the national level and Chinese investment in the gambling industry in Sihanoukville. It argues that the host country’s regulatory strength in combination with different varieties of capital determines the effectiveness of the government's attempts at achieving their development objectives. Using a case study approach based on primary interviews conducted in Phnom Penh and Sihanoukville, this article finds dramatically different outcomes in the two sectors under analysis. In the infrastructure sector, we find that the high regulatory strength deployed by the line ministry in conjunction with Chinese state capital achieves the government’s infrastructure development goals. On the contrary, in the gambling industry in Sihanoukville, limited regulatory strength of the local government coupled with profit-driven short-term capital create a ‘Chinese silo’ that yields limited (or even negative) developmental outcomes. Our analysis shows that regulatory strength can shape and affect the outcomes of foreign capital. These results are supported by the analysis of two shadow cases in manufacturing and real estate. We define this state of affairs as ‘fractured development’.
articles.abstract_cn: 关于发展中国家如何有效管理中国支持的基建和投资（尤其是“一带一路”倡议启动以来）的学术争论，主要集中在跨国差异上。对国内差异的关注较少：为什么一个国家内的某些部门能比其他国家更好地将中国企业的活动与其国内发展目标相结合？本研究通过比较国家层面的中柬基础设施合作与中国在西哈努克市博彩业的投资，考察了国内差异。本文认为，东道国的监管强度与不同类型的资本相结合，决定了政府实现其发展目标的有效性。基于在金边和西哈努克市进行的一手访谈的案例研究方法，本文发现所分析的两个部门的结果截然不同。在基础设施部门，我们发现，行业部委部署的高监管强度与中国国有资本相结合，实现了政府的基础设施发展目标。相反，在西哈努克市的博彩业，地方政府有限的监管强度加上利润驱动的短期资本，形成了一个“中国孤岛”，产生了有限（甚至负面）的发展成果。我们的分析表明，监管强度可以塑造并影响外国资本的结果。这些结果得到了制造业和房地产两个影子案例分析的支撑。我们将这种状况定义为“碎片化发展”。

articles.title_en: Returning from greener pastures? How exposure to returnees affects migration plans
articles.title_cn: 从更绿的牧场归来？接触归国者对移民计划的影响
articles.abstract_en: Information and networks have long been hypothesized to be crucial elements of the formation of emigration intentions. Returnees are a prime source of information about life as a migrant. In this study, we contribute to an emerging literature on the influence of returnees on the formation of migration decisions using representative geolocated data from 5,000 respondents and more than 47,000 family members and relatives from Senegal and The Gambia, two countries with high emigration rates in the past. We demonstrate that the presence of return migrants in a respondent’s vicinity is exogenously conditional on the current number of emigrants. This allows us to circumvent the endogeneity of personal networks and to estimate the effect of returnees on individual emigration intentions. Migration intentions are substantially lower when emigrants who returned from Europe are present in the area. This does not apply to returnees from another African country. Further analyses reveal that migrants who returned from another African country improve the economic situation of families, while non-family returnees from Europe have no lasting economic impact but instead salter people’s negative perceptions of migration. We infer that exposure to returnees depresses emigration plans because potential migrants become more aware of the risks of the migration journey and the stigma attached to returning unsuccessfully.
articles.abstract_cn: 长期以来，信息和网络被认为是形成移民意向的关键因素。归国者是了解移民生活的主要信息来源。在本研究中，我们利用来自塞内加尔和冈比亚的具有代表性的地理定位数据，包括约5,000名受访者及其超过47,000名家庭成员和亲属，这两个国家过去移民率很高，为关于归国者对移民决策形成影响的新兴文献做出贡献。我们证明，受访者附近存在归国移民的情况是外生的，取决于当前的移民数量。这使我们能够规避个人网络的内生性，并估计归国者对个人移民意向的影响。当该地区有从欧洲归国的移民时，移民意向显著降低。这不适用于从其他非洲国家归国的移民。进一步分析显示，从其他非洲国家归国的移民改善了家庭的经济状况，而从欧洲归国的非家庭成员没有持久的经济影响，反而使人们对移民的负面看法更加突出。我们推断，接触归国者会抑制移民计划，因为潜在移民更加意识到移民旅程的风险以及不成功归国所附带的耻辱。

articles.title_en: How to cope with a refugee population? Evidence from Uganda
articles.title_cn: 如何应对难民人口？来自乌干达的证据
articles.abstract_en: Sub-Saharan Africa hosts a large proportion of the world’s refugees, raising concerns about the consequences on host countries. Uganda is the largest refugee-hosting country in Africa and is praised for its progressive refugee policy. We analyze the effects of hosting refugees on material welfare in Uganda, relying on longitudinal data and an instrumental variable approach. Our results indicate that Ugandan households benefit from living close to refugee settlements. In contrast to the existing literature, those initially involved in subsistence agriculture benefit the most. The effect seems to be driven by the few households able to move from subsistence agriculture to commercial farming and to some extent, to wage employment.
articles.abstract_cn: 撒哈拉以南非洲收容了世界上很大比例的难民，这引发了对东道国后果的担忧。乌干达是非洲最大的难民收容国，并因其进步的难民政策而受到赞扬。我们利用纵向数据和工具变量方法，分析了收容难民对乌干达物质福利的影响。我们的结果表明，乌干达家庭因居住在难民定居点附近而受益。与现有文献相反，那些最初从事自给农业的家庭受益最多。这种效应似乎是由少数能够从自给农业转向商业农业，并在一定程度上转向工资就业的家庭所驱动的。

articles.title_en: What makes a program good? Evidence from short-cycle higher education programs in five developing countries
articles.title_cn: 什么使项目优质？来自五个发展中国家短期高等教育项目的证据
articles.abstract_en: Short-cycle higher education programs (SCPs) can play a central role in skill development and higher education expansion, yet their quality varies greatly within and among countries. In this paper, we explore the relationship between programs’ practices and inputs (quality determinants) and student academic and labor market outcomes. We design and conduct a novel survey to collect program-level information on quality determinants and average outcomes for Brazil, Colombia, Dominican Republic, Ecuador, and Peru. Categories of quality determinants include training and curriculum, infrastructure, faculty, link with productive sector, costs and funding, and practices on student admission and institutional governance. We also gather administrative student-level data on higher education and formal employment for SCP students in Brazil and Ecuador and match it to survey data. Using machine learning methods, we select the quality determinants that predict outcomes at the program and student levels. We show that specific quality determinants may favor academic and labor market outcomes. Two practices predict improvements in all labor market outcomes in Brazil and Ecuador—teaching numerical competencies and providing job market information—and one practice—teaching numerical competencies—additionally predicts improvements in labor market outcomes for all survey countries. Since quality determinants account for 20–40 percent of the explained variation in student-level outcomes, quality determinants might have a role shrinking program quality gaps. These findings have implications for the design and replication of high-quality SCPs, their regulation, and the development of information systems.
articles.abstract_cn: 短期高等教育项目（SCPs）在技能发展和高等教育扩张中可以发挥核心作用，但其质量在国家内部和国家之间差异很大。在本文中，我们探讨了项目的实践和投入（质量决定因素）与学生学业和劳动力市场结果之间的关系。我们设计并实施了一项新颖的调查，以收集巴西、哥伦比亚、多米尼加共和国、厄瓜多尔和秘鲁的项目层面质量决定因素和平均结果信息。质量决定因素的类别包括培训和课程、基础设施、师资、与生产部门的联系、成本和资金，以及学生录取和机构治理的实践。我们还收集了巴西和厄瓜多尔SCP学生的高等教育和正规就业的行政学生层面数据，并将其与调查数据匹配。使用机器学习方法，我们选择了在项目和学生层面预测结果的质量决定因素。我们表明，特定的质量决定因素可能有利于学业和劳动力市场结果。在巴西和厄瓜多尔，有两种实践预测了所有劳动力市场结果的改善——教授数值能力和提供就业市场信息——而一种实践——教授数值能力——还额外预测了所有调查国家劳动力市场结果的改善。由于质量决定因素占学生层面结果解释变异的20-40%，质量决定因素可能在缩小项目质量差距方面发挥作用。这些发现对高质量SCP的设计和复制、其监管以及信息系统的开发具有启示意义。

articles.title_en: Impact of a pension program on healthcare utilization among older farmers: Empirical evidence from health claims data
articles.title_cn: 养老金计划对老年农民医疗利用的影响：来自健康索赔数据的实证证据
articles.abstract_en: In many countries, family-owned farms are predominant, with self-employed farmers. When such farmers reach retirement age, they likely do not have access to pensions. Using the farmer pension program in Taiwan as an example, this study examines the effect of access to public pension on healthcare utilization among older farmers. We investigate whether this program affects healthcare utilization, number of visits, and the costs associated with outpatient or inpatient services and prescription drugs. We also explore whether these effects vary by medical specialty and the amount of pension received. By using health claims data from the universal health insurance program and a regression discontinuity design, we find that pension payments significantly increase the number of outpatient visits by 4% and outpatient expenditure by 5%. We also find that pension recipients spend more on family medicine, internal medicine, and Chinese medicine. As the pension program is designed to secure older farmers’ welfare, our results demonstrate an improvement in the health component of individual well-being.
articles.abstract_cn: 在许多国家，家庭经营的农场占主导地位，农民多为自雇人士。当这些农民达到退休年龄时，他们可能无法获得养老金。以台湾的农民养老金计划为例，本研究考察了获得公共养老金对老年农民医疗利用的影响。我们调查该计划是否影响医疗利用、就诊次数以及与门诊或住院服务和处方药相关的费用。我们还探讨了这些影响是否因医学专业和养老金金额而异。通过使用全民健康保险计划的健康索赔数据和断点回归设计，我们发现养老金支付显著增加了门诊就诊次数4%和门诊支出5%。我们还发现，养老金领取者在家庭医学、内科和中医上的支出更多。由于养老金计划旨在保障老年农民的福利，我们的结果表明个人福祉中的健康组成部分得到了改善。

articles.title_en: How political insiders lose out when international aid underperforms: Evidence from a participatory development experiment in Ghana
articles.title_cn: 当国际援助表现不佳时，政治内部人士如何受损：来自加纳参与式发展实验的证据
articles.abstract_en: Although participatory development often aims specifically to mitigate problems from political biases and party-based clientelism, the path is complicated and depends critically on the efficacy of underlying programs as well as how they interact with pre-existing institutions. We provide a framework to understand when participatory development is likely to generate politically biased benefits, showing that even if participatory aid is neutrally allocated, neutral benefit realizations occur only under specific circumstances. We apply this framework to a five-year randomized controlled study of a major participatory development program in Ghana, analyzing the program’s effects on participation in, leadership of, and investment by pre-existing political institutions, and on households’ overall socioeconomic well-being. We find the government and its political supporters acted with high expectations for the participatory approach: treatment led to increased participation in local governance and reallocation of resources. But the results did not meet expectations, resulting in a worsening of socioeconomic wellbeing in treatment versus control villages for government supporters. This demonstrates aid’s complex distributional consequences.
articles.abstract_cn: 尽管参与式发展通常旨在专门缓解政治偏见和党派庇护主义带来的问题，但其路径复杂，且关键取决于基础项目的有效性以及它们与既有制度的互动方式。我们提供了一个框架来理解参与式发展何时可能产生政治偏见的利益，表明即使参与式援助被中立分配，中立的利益实现也仅在特定情况下发生。我们将此框架应用于加纳一个大型参与式发展项目的五年随机对照研究，分析该项目对既有政治制度中的参与、领导力和投资，以及家庭整体社会经济福祉的影响。我们发现政府及其政治支持者对参与式方法抱有高度期望：处理导致了地方治理参与度的提高和资源的重新分配。但结果未达到预期，导致处理村中政府支持者的社会经济福祉相对于对照村有所恶化。这展示了援助复杂的分配后果。

articles.title_en: Drivers of growth accelerations: What role for capital accumulation?
articles.title_cn: 增长加速的驱动因素：资本积累扮演什么角色？
articles.abstract_en: Economic growth is often episodic but the ultimate drivers of such growth accelerations are not understood very well. We therefore take a different perspective and investigate what happens to production factors and productivity before, during, and after 156 growth accelerations that we identify for 148 countries between 1950 and 2019. We are particularly interested in the role that physical capital accumulation can play in this context, given recent interest in investment surges and several investment-led growth models.
articles.abstract_cn: 经济增长往往是间歇性的，但此类增长加速的最终驱动因素尚未被充分理解。因此，我们采取不同的视角，考察在1950年至2019年间为148个国家识别的156次增长加速之前、期间和之后，生产要素和生产率发生了什么变化。鉴于近期对投资激增和若干投资主导型增长模型的关注，我们特别关注实物资本积累在此背景下可能发挥的作用。

articles.title_en: Foreign pressure and public opinion in target states
articles.title_cn: 目标国的外部压力与公众舆论
articles.abstract_en: To influence states’ treatment of their citizens, various foreign actors deploy a broad array of tools, including moral suasion and material assistance. The efficacy of international pressure is often contingent on how publics in target states respond. Employing survey experiments, we examine how two common tools of external influence employed by other countries —verbal condemnation and the threat of aid withdrawal—affect public opinion in three Asian states that have been criticized for their human rights practices: Myanmar, Nepal, and Indonesia. Overall, we find that, in the face of such pressure, preference for the status quo policy becomes stronger among the supporters of incumbent governments in target states. In contrast, those who are not government partisans are more likely to support policy change for better human rights conditions. The latter, however, is the constituency less likely to exert influence on the government to revise its policy. Together, these findings point to the possibility that criticism and aid sanction threats employed by foreign countries will be ineffective or even counterproductive at least in the short run.
articles.abstract_cn: 为影响他国对待其公民的方式，各种外部行为体运用了包括道德劝诫和物质援助在内的广泛工具。国际压力的效力往往取决于目标国公众的反应。通过调查实验，我们考察了其他国家采用的两种常见外部影响工具——口头谴责和援助撤出威胁——如何影响三个因人权实践而受到批评的亚洲国家（缅甸、尼泊尔和印度尼西亚）的公众舆论。总体而言，我们发现，面对此类压力，目标国现任政府支持者对现状政策的偏好会增强。相比之下，非政府党派支持者更可能支持为改善人权状况而进行政策变革。然而，后者是较不可能对政府施加影响以修订其政策的群体。综合来看，这些发现表明，外国采用的批评和援助制裁威胁至少在短期内可能无效甚至适得其反。

articles.title_en: When do anti-bribery laws affect international trade?
articles.title_cn: 反贿赂法何时影响国际贸易？
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies the relationship between anti-corruption enforcement and trade, offering a novel empirical perspective on the OECD Anti-Bribery Convention (ABC), in which signatory countries agreed to prosecute bribery of foreign officials. Existing literature on ABC focuses on its early years, claiming that it led OECD firms to avoid exporting to corrupt destinations, with the effect of diverting business away from developing countries. Yet these early years involved little actual enforcement, and I argue that the redirection of trade in this period owed not to the anti-bribery laws themselves, but to an underlying trend of increased political cooperation among OECD countries, as indicated by several factors including patterns in UN voting affinity. Only when enforcement of the laws intensifies, during the OECD’s Phase 3 initiative, do the laws begin having real effects, diverting OECD countries’ trade away from corrupt destinations.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究反腐败执法与贸易之间的关系，为经合组织《反贿赂公约》（ABC）提供了一个新颖的实证视角，该公约的签署国同意起诉贿赂外国官员的行为。现有关于ABC的文献聚焦于其早期阶段，声称该公约导致经合组织企业避免向腐败目的地出口，其效果是将业务从发展中国家转移出去。然而，这些早期阶段实际上几乎没有执法行为，我认为这一时期贸易的转向并非归因于反贿赂法本身，而是归因于经合组织国家间政治合作增强的潜在趋势，这一趋势由包括联合国投票亲和力模式在内的若干因素所表明。只有当法律执法力度加强，即在经合组织的第三阶段倡议期间，这些法律才开始产生实际效果，将经合组织国家的贸易从腐败目的地转移开。

articles.title_en: How do forests contribute to food security following a weather shock? Evidence from Malawi
articles.title_cn: 森林如何在天气冲击后促进粮食安全？来自马拉维的证据
articles.abstract_en: Rural residents in developing countries are particularly vulnerable to shocks related to weather events. In this context, forests are frequently presented as safety nets, especially for households with limited risk-management options. This analysis aims to provide further evidence on the effectiveness of such safety nets. Specifically, the objective of this work is to analyze the extent to which forests serve as an effective safety net for food security when other potential risk-management options are available, or not, in rural areas. Focusing on agricultural households in Malawi, we combine several rounds of observations from the World Bank's Living Standards Measurement Study-Integrated Surveys on Agriculture (LSMS-ISA) with geospatial data on forest cover and a drought index based on both precipitation and temperature. Our results show that forests play an important role in protecting households’ diets in the aftermath of a weather shock, especially amongst those that appear to have limited insurance options, and/or that may need to further diversify their portfolio of potential insurance mechanisms to cope with a shock. By looking at food security, we highlight both the market and non-market benefits of forest resources in the aftermath of a shock. Moreover, we provide additional empirical evidence on the characteristics of households that depend on forest resources during challenging times. Overall, in light of the fundamental role forests play for human and planetary health, these findings shed light on the need to preserve forest access to forest-dependent communities and strengthen the sustainable management of forest resources.
articles.abstract_cn: 发展中国家的农村居民尤其容易受到与天气事件相关的冲击的影响。在这种背景下，森林常被视为安全网，特别是对于风险管理选择有限的家庭。本分析旨在为这类安全网的有效性提供进一步证据。具体而言，本工作的目标是分析在农村地区，当其他潜在的风险管理选择可用或不可用时，森林在多大程度上充当粮食安全的有效安全网。我们以马拉维的农业家庭为研究对象，将世界银行生活水平测量研究-农业综合调查（LSMS-ISA）的几轮观测数据与森林覆盖的地理空间数据以及基于降水和温度的干旱指数相结合。我们的结果表明，森林在天气冲击后保护家庭饮食方面发挥着重要作用，尤其是在那些保险选择有限和/或可能需要进一步多样化其潜在保险机制组合以应对冲击的家庭中。通过关注粮食安全，我们强调了森林资源在冲击后的市场和非市场效益。此外，我们为在困难时期依赖森林资源的家庭特征提供了额外的实证证据。总体而言，鉴于森林对人类和地球健康所发挥的根本作用，这些发现揭示了需要保护森林依赖社区对森林的获取，并加强森林资源的可持续管理。

articles.title_en: Rethinking agrarian transition in Southeast Asia through rice farming in Thailand
articles.title_cn: 通过泰国水稻种植重新思考东南亚的农业转型
articles.abstract_en: This paper contributes to new understandings of agrarian transition for smallholder rice farming in Southeast Asia through quantitative data analysis from Thailand’s two main rice growing regions. Despite economic modernization models predicting a farm-size transition of smallholder agriculture to large-scale commercial farms with the onset of industrialization and urban employment opportunities, we find rice farmers continue to persist and defy anticipated trends, but not uniformly. We conducted a comprehensive survey in 2019 with rice farming households in twelve provinces in Thailand’s Central Plains and the Northeast on how a host of dynamic farming variables have changed from 2000 to 2019. Rather than the concentration of smallholder rice farms into large commercial farms, we find that the size of smallholder rice farms has remained remarkably consistent across study sites. Our comparative data analysis advances an interrelated set of key explanatory variables that go beyond land size to explicate the variegated nature of agrarian transition: access to resources, household farm labor, farm inputs, agrarian finance, and government support. Our study demonstrates the need for taking into consideration (sub-)regional specificity of material conditions and multi-scaled forces, as well as geographical proximity to advantageous factors, in shaping variegated trajectories of agrarian transition. Smallholder rice farmers and rice production is not about to significantly decline in either region of Thailand nor the rest of Southeast Asia, at least for the next several decades, but will increasingly be defined by changing demographics, growing environmental and climatic challenges, and consolidating global rice production supply chains.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文通过对泰国两个主要水稻种植区的定量数据分析，为理解东南亚小农水稻种植的农业转型提供了新的视角。尽管经济现代化模型预测，随着工业化和城市就业机会的出现，小农农业将向大规模商业化农场转变，但我们发现水稻种植者继续坚持并违背了预期趋势，但并非一致如此。我们在2019年对泰国中部平原和东北部十二个省份的水稻种植农户进行了一项综合调查，了解从2000年到2019年一系列动态农业变量的变化情况。我们发现，小农水稻农场的规模在研究地点之间保持高度一致，而非小农水稻农场集中为大型商业农场。我们的比较数据分析提出了一组相互关联的关键解释变量，这些变量超越了土地规模，用以解释农业转型的多样性：资源获取、家庭农业劳动力、农业投入、农业融资和政府支持。我们的研究表明，需要考虑物质条件的（次）区域特殊性、多尺度力量以及地理邻近有利因素，以塑造农业转型的多样化轨迹。小农水稻种植者和水稻生产在泰国任一地区或东南亚其他地区都不会在至少未来几十年内显著减少，但将日益受到人口结构变化、日益增长的环境和气候挑战以及全球水稻生产供应链整合的影响。

articles.title_en: Links between firm registration and performance: Does it pay to register?
articles.title_cn: 企业注册与绩效之间的联系：注册是否值得？
articles.abstract_en: The informal sector is an important part of Kenya’s economy and contributes significantly to employment creation, production and poverty reduction. The Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME) sector has especially been singled out and prioritized as an important driver of growth, yet close to 80% of MSME in Kenya are informal. The question that arises is whether firm registration limits firm performance. Using data from the 2016 Kenya Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME) survey, we estimate the effect of firm registration on firm performance. We control for self-selection into registration using instrumental variable and coarsened exact matching (CEM) methods. We find that firm registration is associated with between 45% and 51% increase in firm income. For micro firms, registration raises firm income by between 49% and 65%. These findings indicate that formal firms are more productive than informal firms. This holds true even for micro firms. When firms operate informally, they limit their potential performance. Policies that promote and facilitate firm registration can go a long way in increasing productivity of MSME with positive implications for employment creation, production and poverty reduction.
articles.abstract_cn: 非正规部门是肯尼亚经济的重要组成部分，对就业创造、生产和减贫做出了重大贡献。微型、小型和中型企业（MSME）部门尤其被单独列出并优先视为增长的重要驱动力，然而肯尼亚近80%的MSME是非正规的。由此产生的问题是，企业注册是否限制了企业绩效。利用2016年肯尼亚微型、小型和中型企业（MSME）调查的数据，我们估计了企业注册对企业绩效的影响。我们使用工具变量和粗略精确匹配（CEM）方法控制了注册中的自我选择。我们发现，企业注册与企业收入增加45%至51%相关。对于微型企业，注册使企业收入增加49%至65%。这些发现表明，正规企业比非正规企业更具生产力。即使对于微型企业也是如此。当企业非正规经营时，它们限制了自身的潜在绩效。促进和便利企业注册的政策可以在提高MSME生产力方面发挥重要作用，对就业创造、生产和减贫产生积极影响。

articles.title_en: Large-scale monitoring in the DRC’s Ituri forest with a locally informed multidimensional well-being index
articles.title_cn: 刚果民主共和国伊图里森林的大规模监测：基于本地信息的多维福祉指数
articles.abstract_en: To monitor quality of life in changing landscapes and assess impacts of interventions, development scholars and practitioners continue to seek sensitive, flexible, practical means of measuring well-being. An approach that has received relatively little attention from development scholars but that is gaining traction among NGOs is the use of a well-being index derived from a list of locally defined and democratically weighted basic necessities. The Wildlife Conservation Society has been piloting a tool called the Basic Necessities Survey (BNS) in and around protected areas in Central Africa and beyond for over a decade. Adapted from consensual relative poverty metrics developed in the UK and Sweden, BNS data can be used to calculate a Well-being Index (WBI) that is locally relevant and comparable. To demonstrate its applicability in a lower-income context, we present findings from the Ituri Region of the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) where over 2,000 households were surveyed using the BNS tool in 2015, 2017, and 2019. WBI scores were lower among traditionally vulnerable and marginalized groups: Indigenous and female-headed households, those with young or elderly heads, and households that were smaller or had high ratios of dependents. WBI varied with livelihood and geography and was sensitive enough to detect group-specific changes over a short time; namely an economic shock concentrated in villages along the main local highway in 2017 when the DRC experienced a major currency devaluation. Scores can be calculated to either incorporate or isolate variability in subjective expectations about what constitutes well-being; we show that expectations differed for Indigenous households and expectations rose faster than assets in this period. Findings build confidence in the utility of this type of locally informed multidimensional well-being metric in low-income regions. Those seeking practical instruments to produce flexible and regionally comparable well-being measures may wish to consider this approach.
articles.abstract_cn: 为了监测不断变化的景观中的生活质量并评估干预措施的影响，发展学者和实践者继续寻求敏感、灵活、实用的福祉衡量方法。一种在发展学者中相对较少受到关注但在非政府组织中日益流行的做法是使用从本地定义和民主加权的基本必需品清单中得出的福祉指数。野生动物保护协会十多年来一直在中非及更远地区的保护区内外试点一种名为基本必需品调查（BNS）的工具。BNS改编自英国和瑞典开发的共识性相对贫困指标，其数据可用于计算具有本地相关性和可比性的福祉指数（WBI）。为了展示其在低收入背景下的适用性，我们介绍了刚果民主共和国（DRC）伊图里地区的调查结果，该地区在2015年、2017年和2019年使用BNS工具调查了超过2,000户家庭。在传统上脆弱和边缘化的群体中，WBI得分较低：土著和女性户主家庭、户主年轻或年长的家庭，以及规模较小或受抚养人比例较高的家庭。WBI随生计和地理位置而变化，并且足够敏感，能够检测到短期内特定群体的变化；即2017年刚果民主共和国经历重大货币贬值时，主要地方公路沿线村庄集中受到的经济冲击。得分可以计算为纳入或隔离关于福祉构成的主观期望的变异性；我们表明，土著家庭的期望有所不同，且在此期间期望的增长速度快于资产。研究结果增强了对这种本地信息多维福祉指标在低收入地区实用性的信心。那些寻求灵活且区域可比的福祉衡量实用工具的人士不妨考虑这种方法。
